summary.name: Python Developer Tooling Handbook
summary.one_liner: A handbook of opinionated recommendations and trade-offs for Python packaging, linting, formatting, testing, type checking, and dependency management tools.
use_cases: Choosing which Python tools to use today
Setting up a new Python project with standard defaults
Learning what to install on macOS, Windows, or Linux
Comparing Python type checkers and linters
Keeping up with Python packaging and security changes
summary.what_it_does: The site is a handbook that gives opinionated recommendations and honest trade-offs for Python tooling across packaging, linting and formatting, testing, type checking, and dependency management. It has topic hubs, a Modern Python Tooling Checklist, and an installation guide for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Each tool has a Reference page that links to its official documentation. The handbook is meant to complement, not replace, the Python Packaging User Guide and the Scientific Python Library Development Guide. The page also carries a blog with recent posts on uv, Ruff, ty, PyPI, and Python 3.15 changes.
notable: Opinionated tool recommendations with stated trade-offs
Reference pages for each tool linking to official docs
Modern Python Tooling Checklist summarizing defaults on one page
Blog covering recent uv, Ruff, ty, and PyPI changes
caveats: Complements rather than replaces official documentation
Recommendations reflect the author's opinions and may age as tools change
